build_metalwoz_dataset: run the build function to download and extract the MetaLWOZ train and test datasets
download_metalwoz_resources: download the MetaLWOZ train and test zip files from Microsoft servers using RESOURCES
create_metalwoz_directory_structure: create the train and test dialogues directory structure for the MetaLWOZ dataset
extract_metalwoz_test_data: extract the dstc8_metalwoz_heldout zip file into the test dialogues directory
check_metalwoz_build_version: check if the MetaLWOZ dataset is already built at version 1.0 before downloading
